_note: Curated Drugs@FDA sponsor_name token -> ticker map for the openFDA approval channel (collectors/openfda.py). The token is matched as an exact phrase: sponsor_name:"<token>" (openFDA stores SHORT uppercase applicant names, e.g. 'LILLY', 'NOVO NORDISK', 'GENENTECH'). Fills the healthcare blind spot Quiver/contracts cannot see: new-drug (ORIG/AP) approvals and label expansions (SUPPL/EFFICACY/AP). Clinical-stage names (VKTX/GPCR/ALT/SRRK) are kept so their FIRST approval fires the channel; they simply return nothing until then. Payers (UNH/ELV/CI/HUM/CNC/CVS) make no drugs -> intentionally absent (openFDA is structurally blind to them). ADRs map to the US-listed ticker.
